pyExpressionMapNew.rowdata: "AND NVL( ( SELECT p.reinsurer FROM pooldata.pega_dashboardpnc p WHERE p.noklaim = a.pyid ), ( SELECT DECODE(m.mds_jn_coas, '0','1', '1','1', '2','2', 'F','F') FROM ( SELECT mds_jn_coas, ROW_NUMBER() OVER ( PARTITION BY mds_no_polis ORDER BY TO_NUMBER(mds_prod_ke) DESC ) rn FROM mst_det_sales@asmd.sinarmas.co.id WHERE mds_no_polis = a.policyno ) m WHERE rn = 1 ) ) = '"+tempFilter.ClaimNo+"'"
